params.body:
## What

The page for step 1 of three: someone at the desk, without technical knowledge, looks at what comes in before saying "that is too much, that is too little". It reads `GET /mix` from the pipeline (gentells-pipeline#193, merge that one first; until then this page says the mix could not be read).

Under Data, after Sources: **Mix**.

- One sentence on top: how much came in, against the window before, what share was kept, how many a reading names.
- Two choices as text that behaves, not pills: the axis (platform, kind of evidence, language, region, sector, cohort) and the window (day, week, month, quarter).
- One table, biggest first. The bar is a groove: the track is what came in, the fill is the part that was kept. That is the only colour on the page.
- "new" where the window before had nothing, instead of a percentage against zero.
- On a tag axis the page says that shares add up to more than the whole, and how many signals carry no tag.
- Like Collection it states facts and judges nothing. It sets nothing either: wishes and dials are the next two steps, so that what a dial does can be read here a week later.

## Checked

What CI runs: the lint ratchet stays at its ceiling (49 errors, 26 warnings), the build passes, and all 20 Playwright tests pass, three of them new (the numbers and their order, switching to a tag axis, reaching the page from the Data menu).

Known and left for later: platform rows carry the pipeline's own keys (`web`, `toutiao`), not display names.
params.title: Mix: what came in, along one axis, for someone at the desk
